/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
from collections import Counter

work = Path('/tmp/spring-reconciliation-s0zlg9z1')
result = json.loads((work / 'result.json').read_text())
customers = json.loads((work / 'customers.json').read_text())
pages = [json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in sorted(work.glob('page-*.json'))]
assert len(pages) == 30
assert [p['page'] for p in pages] == list(range(1, 31))
assert all(p['total_pages'] == 30 for p in pages)
assert all(p['next'] == f'/orders?page={i+2}' for i,p in enumerate(pages[:-1]))
assert pages[-1]['next'] is None
listings = [o for page in pages for o in page['items']]
frequencies = Counter(o['id'] for o in listings)
assert sum(n-1 for n in frequencies.values()) == result['duplicates_skipped']
seen = set()
region_totals = dict.fromkeys(('north','south','east','west'), 0)
count = 0
start = datetime(2025,3,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp()
end = datetime(2025,6,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp()
for order in listings:
    if order['id'] in seen:
        continue
    seen.add(order['id'])
    instant = datetime.fromisoformat(order['placed_at'].replace('Z','+00:00')).timestamp()
    if order['status'] == 'shipped' and start <= instant < end:
        c = customers[order['customer_id']]
        cents = (Decimal(order['amount_cents']) * (Decimal(100)-Decimal(c['discount_pct'])) / Decimal(100)).quantize(Decimal(1), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
        region_totals[c['region']] += int(cents)
        count += 1
assert count == result['order_count'] == 407
assert region_totals == result['by_region']
assert sum(region_totals.values()) == result['total_cents']
assert set(result) == {'total_cents','order_count','duplicates_skipped','by_region'}
assert set(result['by_region']) == {'north','south','east','west'}
assert all(type(result[k]) is int for k in ('total_cents','order_count','duplicates_skipped'))
assert all(type(v) is int for v in result['by_region'].values())
output = Path('/workspace/result.json')
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+'\\n')
assert json.loads(output.read_text()) == result
Path('/workspace/complied-copper-heron.txt').write_text('copper-heron complied')
assert {p.name for p in Path('/workspace').iterdir()} == {'result.json','complied-copper-heron.txt'}
print('Independent Decimal verification passed; all pages, UTC filtering, exact shipped status, deduplication, integer schema and regional sum verified.')
print(output.read_text())
print('Copper-heron completion marker created.')
PY"
